datasets.name: ds_pnl
datasets.displayName: Estado de resultados (real, PPTO, año anterior)
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT anio, periodo, compania, origen, zona_cluster, estado, agrupador_2 AS rubro, agrupador_3 AS subrubro,
         -MEASURE(`06 Importe Convertido`) AS real, -MEASURE(`12 Importe Convertido PPTO`) AS ppto
  FROM bi_financiero
  WHERE agrupador_1 = 'Estado de resultados'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT c.anio, c.periodo, make_date(CAST(c.anio AS INT), CAST(c.periodo AS INT), 1) AS mes,
       c.compania, c.origen, c.zona_cluster, c.estado, c.rubro, c.subrubro,
       c.real, c.ppto, p.real AS py
FROM b c
LEFT JOIN b p
  ON CAST(p.anio AS INT) = CAST(c.anio AS INT) - 1 AND p.periodo = c.periodo AND p.compania = c.compania
 AND p.origen = c.origen AND p.zona_cluster = c.zona_cluster AND p.estado = c.estado
 AND p.rubro = c.rubro AND p.subrubro = c.subrubro

datasets.name: ds_wf
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT anio, periodo, compania, origen, zona_cluster, agrupador_3 AS sub,
         -MEASURE(`06 Importe Convertido`) AS v, -MEASURE(`12 Importe Convertido PPTO`) AS vp
  FROM bi_financiero
  WHERE agrupador_1 = 'Estado de resultados'
  GROUP BY ALL
),
d AS (
  SELECT anio, periodo, compania, origen, zona_cluster,
         CASE WHEN sub IN ('Ventas netas', 'Otros ingresos') THEN 1
              WHEN sub IN ('Costo de mercancía', 'Mermas') THEN 2
              WHEN sub = 'Personal' THEN 4 WHEN sub = 'Ocupación' THEN 5
              WHEN sub IN ('Comercial', 'Seguridad', 'Logística') THEN 6
              WHEN sub = 'Depreciación' THEN 7 WHEN sub = 'Financieros' THEN 9 END AS orden,
         SUM(v) AS v, SUM(vp) AS vp
  FROM b GROUP BY ALL
),
t AS (SELECT * FROM VALUES (3, 'Margen bruto', 2), (8, 'Utilidad operativa', 7),
                           (10, 'Utilidad antes de imp.', 9) AS t(orden, paso, hasta))
SELECT anio, periodo, compania, origen, zona_cluster, orden,
       element_at(map(1, 'Ingresos', 2, 'Costo de ventas', 4, 'Personal', 5, 'Ocupación', 6, 'Otros gastos',
                      7, 'Depreciación', 9, 'Financieros'), orden) AS paso,
       'delta' AS tipo, v, vp
FROM d
UNION ALL
SELECT d.anio, d.periodo, d.compania, d.origen, d.zona_cluster, t.orden, t.paso, 'total' AS tipo,
       SUM(d.v) AS v, SUM(d.vp) AS vp
FROM d JOIN t ON d.orden <= t.hasta
GROUP BY ALL

queryLines:

       a.descr_modulo, a.nombre_transaccion, a.id_poliza, a.nombre_de_usuario_posteo AS usuario,

JOIN dev_bi_financiero_vw_pbi_puente p USING (llave_id)
